evals.prompt: I have a folder of markdown files from a course I'm writing. The blockquotes and tables seem to render wrong when I preview them. Can you check and fix the markdown syntax in /tmp/test-md-basic/?
evals.expected_output: All .md files in the directory should have: blockquotes with content on the same line as >, tables with proper separator rows and closing pipes, numbered lists with content on the same line as the number.

evals.prompt: The code blocks in my markdown documentation lost all their indentation — everything is flush left. Can you fix the code block formatting in /tmp/test-md-code/?
evals.expected_output: TSX/JSX/TS/JSON code blocks should have proper indentation restored via prettier. JSON blocks without language tags should be detected and formatted. Code that prettier can't parse should be left unchanged.

evals.prompt: My markdown files have a bunch of issues — broken blockquotes, tables that don't render as tables, some numbered lists that look weird, and the YAML code blocks are all flattened. Can you clean up everything in /tmp/test-md-mixed/?
evals.expected_output: All syntax issues fixed: blockquotes, tables, numbered lists, and YAML indentation. Code blocks in TSX/JSON formatted with prettier. Verification shows no remaining issues.
